transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling to cope after a really stressful event that happened about two months ago. Since then, I've been dealing with a mix of severe anxiety, constant worry, and a really low, depressed mood. It feels like a reaction to the stress that I just can't seem to shake off on my own.
Could you tell me a little more about the stressful event that happened two months ago? Also, are you experiencing any unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks related to it?

It was a major setback at work that really disrupted my life, but I'd rather not go into too much detail about the event itself. I don't experience any nightmares, flashbacks, or unwanted memories about it. It's just that my struggles with constant worry and low mood started right after it happened two months ago.
Along with your low mood, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy? Does this feeling persist nearly all day, every day?

I definitely feel a very low mood and find myself feeling hopeless or tearful quite a bit. But I'm not really sure if I've completely lost interest in my usual activities, or if this heavy feeling persists all day, every day. It seems to fluctuate throughout the day.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or daily energy levels since this started two months ago?
I'm not really sure if there have been any major changes in my sleep or appetite. My energy levels fluctuate a bit depending on my mood, but nothing seems significantly different than usual.
Have you been experiencing any strong feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt since this happened? Also, have you had any thoughts of death or hurting yourself?
No, I haven't felt worthless or experienced any excessive guilt since this started. I also definitely haven't had any thoughts of death or wanting to hurt myself.
